prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high for neutral or negative changes, but too low for winning tests.
Sign-in reorder changes were helpful in 2 tests, while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign changes made performance worse in 2 tests and showed no clear effect in 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made performance worse in 2 tests and showed no clear effect in 1 test.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path reorder, finish redesign, and sign_in notification (1 test each), while adoption new_flow had mixed results across 2 tests (1 worse, 1 won).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +1.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -4.5% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -4.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -7.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -2.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +8.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.2% after noise correction, 4 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 86.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Interactive Persona Cards: Redesign the path selection screen with an interactive card layout highlighting pet traits and playstyles. (why: 23.8% drop off at path selection, with a very high mean duration of 514s indicating user decision paralysis.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Selection Direct Gallery Flow: Introduce a fast-track gallery flow on pick_friend allowing immediate avatar selection without complex configuration. (why: Adoption drop off is 28.3% with a long mean duration of 1017s, showing friction during pet setup.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Auto-Save Security Note: Display an explicit helper hint on sign-in clarifying that account sign-in locks pet progress safely to the cloud. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Placement Verification New Screen: Add a final onboarding verification screen to test and confirm pet visibility on the desktop background. (why: Finish step has a high drop-off rate (35.2%), and support received 3 emails about pets failing to appear on desktop.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Stage Live Activity Feed: Add dynamic activity updates and asset rendering progress info to the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step takes mean 2336s with an 18.7% drop rate during pet generation.)
5: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Reassurance Headline Copy: Update headline copy on photo upload screen assuring users that default pets are generated if photos fail. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results.)
6: [home, notification] Background Pet Render System Notification: Enable desktop notifications when pet generation completes while the app is minimized. (why: Mean time on waiting stage is 2336s, indicating users leave the window idle during processing.)
7: [finish, layout] Home Intro Controls Overview Layout: Re-layout home intro into a split screen showcasing primary controls and system tray interactions. (why: Support received 3 emails from users unclear on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-setup.)
8: [choose_path, incentive] Story Screen Path Selector Motivation Badge: Add a highlight badge on the story screen introducing path selection benefits and unlockable companion traits. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users and has an 8s median / 514s mean time.)

scores.note: Choose_path has high duration, but full screen redesigns carry execution risk.
Adoption step has 28.3% drop off; new_flow history is mixed but slightly positive (+1.9%).
Sign-in changes consistently perform well and 8 support emails show direct user friction.
Adding new screens to finish step consistently degraded performance in past tests (-4.0%).
Home step drop-off is 18.7% with long wait time; activity feed helps set expectations.
Low-cost copy reassurance addresses direct support complaints during adoption.
Addresses high background idle time (2336s mean) with minimal engineering overhead.
Finish stage redesigns/layout changes historically underperform (-7.7%).
Low cost badge addition targeting decision hesitation at choose_path.
